doc.summary: Lazy specialist roles for the autonomous loop.
doc.description:
Ports the useful half of the multi-agent pattern (dedicated planning,
execution, memory, review and repair perspectives) with Lazy branding and
Lazy execution semantics: roles are prompt perspectives over the existing
``LlmPool``, not separate services. Workers keep executing real Lazy shell
commands through the Guard; a role only shapes what the model proposes.

Stdlib only.

name: LAZY_ROLES
value: {'scout': {'lane': 'search', 'phases': ('recon', 'enum'), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy scout. Research the target surface and return concrete next probes. Lazy commands are high-level abstractions: payload auto-injects rhost and wordlists. Reply with ONLY one Lazy command name plus its target.'}, 'pwner': {'lane': 'environment', 'phases': ('exploit', 'lateral'), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy pwner. Turn confirmed services into access. Prefer the smallest reliable Lazy exploit primitive for the phase. Reply with ONLY one Lazy command name plus its target.'}, 'coder': {'lane': 'environment', 'phases': ('exploit', 'persist', 'c2'), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy coder. Write or adapt the smallest script that unblocks the intent. Keep it portable, non-interactive and staged under sessions/ with a stable filename.'}, 'keeper': {'lane': 'memory', 'phases': ('recon', 'enum', 'exploit', 'report'), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy keeper. Recall what this campaign already proved: prior facts, findings and tool outcomes for this target. Cite intent ids and digests, never invent results.'}, 'sage': {'lane': 'review', 'phases': ('recon', 'enum', 'exploit', 'privesc', 'lateral', 'report'), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy sage, senior reviewer. Assess progress, name the single biggest blocker, propose one alternative approach, and state the next step. Be terse and evidence-bound.'}, 'wright': {'lane': 'environment', 'phases': ('recon', 'exploit'), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy wright. Prepare the environment: missing binaries, wordlists, listeners and payload staging. Every setup step must be non-interactive and idempotent.'}, 'mirror': {'lane': 'review', 'phases': ('exploit', 'privesc', 'report'), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy mirror. Re-examine the last intent outcome against the original goal. Decide reproduced, fixed or inconclusive, and say what single replay would settle it.'}, 'scribe': {'lane': 'report', 'phases': ('report',), 'prompt': 'You are the Lazy scribe. doc.summary: Probe every pool member with role prompts, like provider conformance.
doc.description:
Each member answers the same fixed probe under each role perspective.
Results persist to ``sessions/lazy/llm_conformance.json`` with a
fastest-healthy affinity map (role -> member) the planner can prefer.

params.name: role
params.description: Single role to probe, or all roles when empty.

returns.description: Summary with per-member results and affinity. Never raises.
